question: List the five product categories with the greatest all-time item sales.

evidence.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(i.price),2) AS sales_brl FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY sales_brl DESC LIMIT 5
